messages:
Kai: Final reminder — changelog cutoff for v0.9.7 in ~6h. If you expect a bump, add an entry now and tag the PR with `changelog/entry` and set the milestone.
Alex: Will add a short one-liner for session-cache fix (PR #4210) — planning to merge in the next hour.
Maria: Quick Q: should we include the infra backport to release/0.9? I can add it if yes.
Sahil: Yes, include it under Bugfixes (internal). Keep the one-liner style: Component: brief action/outcome.
Jen: FYI I trimmed the changelog template in the repo — use this shape:
```
- backend: fix session cache crash when TTL expired (#4210)
- infra: backport CI fix to release/0.9 (#4205) [internal]
```
Kai: Small checklist before cutoff: 1) add entry, 2) tag PR `changelog/entry`, 3) set milestone v0.9.7, 4) run changelog-lint.
Alex: tagged and added entry, awaiting CI.
Maria: added infra line, labeled internal, pinging @release-bot to run changelog-lint.
release-bot: changelog-lint: running
release-bot: changelog-lint: passed (files changed: 2)
Jen: Can we also hold branch merges if bump not set? Suggest we gate merges without `bump: yes` label — reduces post-cutoff churn.
Sahil: +1. We'll do a quick branch queue sweep at T-2h and flag any merges missing labels.
Kai: thanks all. If anything blocks, drop a quick note here — otherwise we'll close the cutoff at the time above. :thumbsup:
